title: UO 디자이너 Oaks와의 인터뷰
bodyHtml:
The Daily Herald (http://ds180.net/news/)의 포럼에 재미있는 글이 하나 올라왔습니다. Noleeens라는 플레이어가 UO 개발자 Oaks와 가진 인터뷰입니다. 울온에 대한 비전과 흥미로운 정보들이 실려 있어서 전문 번역을 했으나 '等新'이라는 단어가 포함되었다는 이유로 다 날라갔습니다 -o- 하여 일단 원문을 옮겨 놓고 중요한 부분들만 번역하도록 하겠습니다.

I had the opportunity to have a little chat with Oaks last night... here's what transpired:

Noleeens: Thank you for agreeing to the interview :) Why dont we start with you, and a bit of your background.... What lead up to you working for OSI? MMORPG background? Love of code?

Oaks: I love coding, RPGs, and especially online RPGs...
Oaks: I've actually been coding and playing on text-based MUDs for about 11 years now.

Noleeens: Do you actively play UO?

Oaks: And of course, I was (still am) a big UO player.

* Noleeens smiles and nods

Noleeens: How many tamers do you have? heh

Oaks: I have 2 tamers. One is completely pathetic, and the other I'm quite fond of playing.

Noleeens: Are these on your original 'private' account.. characters that you yourself have built? or some sort of uber work account?

Oaks: I've recently become quite the "pet trainer" with the new Animal Lore gump and accelerated pet skill gain.

Oaks: We don't actually play with our uber accounts, except on Test Center... and that's just testing. So, yes, they are on my own personal account that I had before I started working at OSI.

Noleeens: Was 'Lord Oaks the Forest Champion' named after you? :)

Oaks: As a matter of fact, he was. =) FierYiCe named them all after something... although some of them are more to do with the monster itself than an inside joke or easter egg.

Oaks: Like Rikktor... since he has an earthquake attack.

* Noleeens chuckles
* Oaks smiles.

Noleeens: You wrote an article awhile back on 'The Value of Rideables' ... we have the swamp dragon and the Fire Steed has been seen on Pacific (I play GL, so haven't seen him yet)... Ive read about Sea Horses.... will we see those anytime soon? Or anything else for that matter?

Oaks: Sea horses present some rather challenging technology issues... but I can say with a fairly high degree of certainty that you'll see some more rideables in the future, although I'm not saying for certain what they'll be. =)
...하지만 차후 새로운 탈것이 계속 도입될 가능성이 크다는 사실을 말씀드릴 수 있습니다. 확실히 무엇인지는 단언할 수 없지만요. =)

Noleeens: Bonded pets being summoned via the summon creature spell was removed from Pub 16 in favor of a different solution that "may be implemented in a future publish" ... can you shed any light on that?

Oaks: I'm not implementing it personally, so I can't say for sure if it will happen.
Oaks: If it does get implemented, I think people will really like it. How's that for vague?

Noleeens: :P
* Noleeens laughs

Noleeens: I knew I would get some of those answers hehe so its all good *grins*
Noleeens: You made the statement that pets would 'no longer walk through moongates by themselves. They will follow their owner through a gate, however.' Will this have any effect on gating a pet out - - for PvP purposes?

Oaks: Oh yes. You can no longer gate away someone's pet. So they'll have to deal with the pet in other ways in a PvP situation.
Oaks: You know, like trying to kill it or something. Or perhaps just running.
네. 다른 플레이어의 애완동물을 게이트로 통과시켜 제거할 수 없습니다. 그러므로 PvP 상황에서 다른 방법을 사용하여 애완동물을 다뤄야 하겠지요. 뭐, 예를 들어 직접 죽인다거나, 아님 그냥 토낀다거나.

Noleeens: Both good ideas :)
Noleeens: Can you tell Ive been scowering the boards? heh.... One more animal related clarification question....

Oaks: Okee!

Noleeens: Frenzied ostards have been known to eat fruit in the past and your response was that 'meat is the preferred food... but it'll eat other things' .... Does what you feed it have any effect on the loyalty of the pet?
예전에 광폭 오타가 과일을 먹었고 이에 대해 Oaks님께서는 '고기가 주식이지만... 다른 것도 먹습니다' 라고 말씀하셨었죠... 무얼 먹이느냐에 따라 충성도에 대한 효과가 달라지나요?

Oaks: Nope. Preferred food is just their favorite food to eat. It doesn't have any in-game effects if you feed it a preferred food versus just any old food it will eat.
아닙니다. 주식은 동물이 가장 좋아하는 음식일 뿐입니다. 어떤 음식을 먹이든지 게임 내에서의 효과는 동일하지요.

Oaks: Although those slimes really love to eat heating stands.
Oaks: Mmmmmm.

Noleeens: .....
Noleeens: Whats your favorite change with Pub 16?

Oaks: Ohh...
Oaks: It's a toss-up between accelerated pet skill gain and the champion spawn.

Noleeens: Can you explain accelerated pet skill gain?
Noleeens: Well... would you? :) *knows you can*

Oaks: They basically learn twice as fast as players.
Oaks: Although they don't use GGS.
애완동물은 기본적으로 사람보다 2배 빠른 속도로 스킬을 익힙니다. GGS의 적용은 받지 않지만요.

Noleeens: So no GGS hehe
Noleeens: How long will it take me to train up a freshly tamed nightmare using the new system?
갓 테임된 나이트메어를 새 시스템에 따라 조련하는데에 어느 정도의 시간이 걸릴까요?

Oaks: Wrestling, Tactics and Anatomy could be GM'd in a week if you killed consistently for a couple hours each night...
Oaks: Magery and Eval Int go up more slowly though
Oaks: Because they don't cast nearly as much as they bite.
레슬링 택틱스 그리고 아나토미는 매일 몇시간씩 꾸준히 투자하신다면 1주일만에 GM으로 만들 수 있으실 거예요. 매저리와 이벨은 조금 더 천천히 오르구요. 나메는 마법공격보다 물리공격을 더 자주 사용하기 때문이죠.

Noleeens: How will this effect legacy pets? Will the system evaluate them for how much they are already trained?
퍼블리쉬 적용 이전의 애완동물들은 어떻게 되나요? 어느 정도까지 조련되어 있는지 새 시스템이 파악을 하나요?

* Noleeens has had the same white wyrm for over a year

Oaks: It treats all pets the same.
Oaks: It's impossible to tell how much Magery they should have trained, so they just start their traing from whatever they happen to be at.
모든 애완동물을 똑같이 취급합니다. 어느 정도까지 수련되어 있어야 한다는 기준이 없으므로, 퍼블리쉬 적용 시점의 스킬치를 그대로 사용할 것입니다.

Noleeens: How are the stats of a freshly spawned animal determined? And do you have figures on how wide the gap is? IE, I tame two drakes... one is obviously far weaker than the other....
새로 스폰된 생물들의 스텟치는 어떻게 결정되나요? 그 범위가 어느 정도 되는지에 관한 자료 같은건 없나요? 예를 들어서, 전 두마리의 드레이크를 데리고 있는데... 한녀석은 다른녀석보다 훨씬 약하더라구요...

Oaks: They are determined with a random range, specific for each stat and skill on each pet. So...
Oaks: A drake, for example... (looks at the code)
Oaks: Spawns with between 133 and 152 dexterity
Oaks: and 401 to 430 strength
Oaks: the skills have a range of about 65.0 to 85.0
Oaks: so it's very possible to get a drake that is much stronger than another
스텟치는 각 생물별로 지정된 일정 범위 내에서 랜덤하게 결정됩니다. 즉... 드레이크라면...(표를 본다) 덱스는 133에서 152 사이에서 결정되구요, 힘은 401에서 430, 그리고 스킬치는 65.0에서 85.0 사이에 위치합니다. 그러므로 드레이크 하나가 다른 녀석보다 훨씬 강할 수 있는 것이지요.

Noleeens: That became very evident at a Drake Tournament this past Sunday :)
Noleeens: Next to no training on the animal and he placed very well.... suprised us all

Oaks: Indeed! It it my hopes that people can use the new Animal Lore skill to weed out the weakling drakes
Oaks: It's best that the weak drakes just be put out of their misery.

* Noleeens laughs
Noleeens: Poor little fellas.... a new market perhaps for runts?

Oaks: Cannon fodder.

Noleeens: And your least favorite change in Pub 16?

Oaks: I really do like all of them... although the housing changes don't affect my play characters at all, because I don't own any houses.

Noleeens: You live out of your bankbox?
* Noleeens shudders at the thought

Oaks: I'm a minimalist.

Noleeens: And I own far too much pixel crack

Oaks: Nothing wrong with that!

Noleeens: Thanks... and hear I thought I was just a packrat hehe
Noleeens: erm here
Noleeens: So since you have been with OSI what is the one change that you have been responsible for that stick out most in your mind?

Oaks: I think my favorite was not having to cut bandages one at a time...

Noleeens: that was you?!
Noleeens: nice!

Oaks: The little things are often some of the best.

Noleeens: Have you customized your music ingame at all? We were wondering if there was someway we could get a list of what music plays when so we can effectively customize our worlds :)

Oaks: That's something you could bug ******<name removed to lessen the mail the fella might recieve... but Im on it!!> about (our lead client programmer)... I've yet to customize mine though.

Noleeens: I think I read somewhere.. and I could be mixing things up here.... but didn't you work on the magic system a bit?

Oaks: Yup. I've worked on it quite a bit. I revamped the low-level spells awhile back, I just worked on the 8th circle summon spells in publish 16, and I did nearly all of the particle effects in Third Dawn.

Noleeens: Can we expect any new spells in the future? Maybe see that mystical 9th circle put to use?
새로운 마법들을 기대해도 될까요? 어쩌면 그 신비로운 9써클 마법도 도입될지도..?

Oaks: Yes. And probably not... maybe?
네. 그리고 아마 안될걸요...어~~~쩌면?

Noleeens: bah!
흥!

Noleeens: Going back for a moment to that article you wrote about The Value of Rideables.... There was a pic with that article of a 'sand vortex'......
Noleeens: Have I just not been in the right place at the right time? or has this not actually been implemented yet?

Oaks: It has not yet been introduced into the game.
Oaks: I'm not quite sure when it *will* be introduced, either. That's the scenario team's thing.

Noleeens: OK... now the fun part - where you get to skirt alot of questions :) (All the stuff not related to taming specifically)

Oaks: Ok

Noleeens: Recently we've seen some GM controlled spawns/mini-invasions, is something being implemented that will lead to this happening on a more regular basis?
최근에 GM이 직접 관여하는 몬스터 스폰이나 침략 이벤트가 있어 왔는데요, 이런 것들이 더 정기적으로 시행되도록 어떤 조치가 취해지고 있는건가요..?

Oaks: I honestly don't know. If it's extremelly popular, there's always a good chance it'll happen more often. =)
솔직히 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 만약 그 이벤트들의 인기가 좋다면, 분명히 더욱 자주 열릴 가능성이 크겠지요.=)

Noleeens: Stellerex was involved in game of chess... and I have seen talk of something referred to as a 'Tajima Hunt' ... is there a move to get the Dev team more exposure ingame?

Oaks: I know all (well, at least most) the dev members are for it... it's a matter of organizing it and finding time now.

Noleeens: neat!

Oaks: No promises, but I'd certainly like to get involved myself and hunt down Tajima.

Noleeens: Marriage deeds and inscribed rings.... is that something still being worked on? or has it fallen off the plate for now?
결혼 디드와 이름이 새겨진 반지... 아직 기획중인가요? 아니면 지금은 보류중?

Oaks: We were talking about that the other day. It's definitely fallen off the plate for now.
그것에 관해 토론을 했었습니다. 지금은 전면 보류중이예요.

Noleeens: 4th and 5th year vet rewards.... any status?
4년차 5년차 올드비 보상품에 관해서는.. 무슨 소식이라도?

Oaks: No status on them, sorry to say.
그것에 대해선 아무런 구상도 되어 있지 않아요. 죄송합니다.

Noleeens: What about Item Bless Deeds.... perhaps a vendor that could bless an article of clothing for you for xxx gold pieces or something like that - will we have the ability to bless clothing again in the future?
아이템 블레스 디드는요..? 특정 벤더에게 일정량의 돈을 지불하면 옷 한벌을 블레스 해주는건 어떨까나.. 예전처럼 언젠가 옷에 블레스를 걸 수 있게 될까요?

Oaks: Clothing bless deeds are part of the tailoring BOD rewards in pub16.
옷 블레스 디드는 퍼블리쉬 16 테일러링 BOD 보상품중의 하나입니다.

* Noleeens jaw drops
Noleeens: I hadn't read that!
그건 들어본 적도 없는데요!

Oaks: I believe they are one of the very high rewards.
분명 최고급 보상품중 하나이겠지요.

Noleeens: What else is part of that new system? hehe

Oaks: The new hued cloth has been a hot item.
Oaks: There's a cloth hue that looks just like the fire steed. =)
새로운 색조의 천이 인기가 있더군요. 그 중에는 파이어 스티드와 똑같은 색도 있지요. =)

Noleeens: That will be fun to play with!
Noleeens: Any other insight into the high end rewards?

Oaks: Those are the only 2 that come to mind. Hanse is the expert in that field.

Noleeens: If you could say anything to the old school players that are feeling a bit discouraged with the changes that are coming in with Pub 16.... what would you say?
퍼블리쉬 16의 변경점에 실망한 올드비들에게 전할 말이 있다면..?

Oaks: If, for some strange reason, they didn't find something wonderful in publish 16, I'd just suggest they sit tight because we are working on some k3wl stuffs.
Oaks: Of which I cannot say any more!
만약 그들이 이런저런 이유로 인해 퍼블리쉬 16에서 마음에 드는 부분을 하나도 찾아내지 못한다면, 지금 대단히 멋진 것들을 개발중이므로 긴장하고 기다리시라는 말을 전하고 싶습니다. 더 자세한 건 가르쳐드릴 수 없어요!

* Noleeens nods
Noleeens: Of course :)
Noleeens: That concludes the UO portion of the interview Oaks... but I still have two more questions :)

Oaks: Ask away!

Noleeens: If you could blend time periods, things, people, and events into a day's adventure, where would you be and with who?

Oaks: I'd go back in time to when I didn't know anything about UO, and just play... exploring and meeting new people while I trekked across Brit was the best time I ever had in UO. Many a Mountain Dew and bag of potato chips provided sustance for 15+ hour sessions back then...

Noleeens: hehe
Noleeens: If the dead were to return to life as flesh-eating zombies, where would you hide out?
* Noleeens loves those two questions

Oaks: I'd cut off my hand, attach a chainsaw, load my double-barrel and wade into them... awyeah.

Noleeens: heh
Noleeens: Thanks again for your time Oaks :)


Noleeens: one more thing... since you didn't run out the door

Oaks: Sure.

Noleeens: What other games are you playing? or have you tried and set aside recently? DAoC? Dungeon Siege? NWN?

Oaks: NWN and Warcraft III
Oaks: Nearly everyone at the office is playing NWN. It's a great game.
...사무실의 거의 모든 사람들이 네버윈터 나이츠를 플레이하고 있습니다. 정말 대단한 게임이예요.

Noleeens: Ahhh someone gonna host a world?

Oaks: And I recently finished Arcanum.
Oaks: Oh, we're considering it. =)
Oaks: Most of us are still just playing through the main module.

Noleeens: Thanks again.



____________________________________________________________

다시 하려니 힘이 빠져서..-o-

Noleeens: So no GGS hehe Noleeens: How long will it take me to train up a freshly tamed nightmare using the new system? 갓 테임된 나이트메어를 새 시스템에 따라 조련하는데에 어느 정도의 시간이 걸릴까요? Oaks: Wrestling, Tactics and Anatomy could be GM'd in a week if you killed consistently for a couple hours each night... Oaks: Magery and Eval Int go up more slowly though Oaks: Because they don't cast nearly as much as they bite. 레슬링 택틱스 그리고 아나토미는 매일 몇시간씩 꾸준히 투자하신다면 1주일만에 GM으로 만들 수 있으실 거예요. 매저리와 이벨은 조금 더 천천히 오르구요. 나메는 마법공격보다 물리공격을 더 자주 사용하기 때문이죠. Noleeens: How will this effect legacy pets? Will the system evaluate them for how much they are already trained? 퍼블리쉬 적용 이전의 애완동물들은 어떻게 되나요? 어느 정도까지 조련되어 있는지 새 시스템이 파악을 하나요? * Noleeens has had the same white wyrm for over a year Oaks: It treats all pets the same. Oaks: It's impossible to tell how much Magery they should have trained, so they just start their traing from whatever they happen to be at. 모든 애완동물을 똑같이 취급합니다. 어느 정도까지 수련되어 있어야 한다는 기준이 없으므로, 퍼블리쉬 적용 시점의 스킬치를 그대로 사용할 것입니다. Noleeens: How are the stats of a freshly spawned animal determined? And do you have figures on how wide the gap is? IE, I tame two drakes... one is obviously far weaker than the other.... 새로 스폰된 생물들의 스텟치는 어떻게 결정되나요? 그 범위가 어느 정도 되는지에 관한 자료 같은건 없나요? 예를 들어서, 전 두마리의 드레이크를 데리고 있는데... 한녀석은 다른녀석보다 훨씬 약하더라구요... Oaks: They are determined with a random range, specific for each stat and skill on each pet. So... Oaks: A drake, for example... (looks at the code) Oaks: Spawns with between 133 and 152 dexterity Oaks: and 401 to 430 strength Oaks: the skills have a range of about 65.0 to 85.0 Oaks: so it's very possible to get a drake that is much stronger than another 스텟치는 각 생물별로 지정된 일정 범위 내에서 랜덤하게 결정됩니다. 즉... 드레이크라면...(표를 본다) 덱스는 133에서 152 사이에서 결정되구요, 힘은 401에서 430, 그리고 스킬치는 65.0에서 85.0 사이에 위치합니다. 그러므로 드레이크 하나가 다른 녀석보다 훨씬 강할 수 있는 것이지요. Noleeens: That became very evident at a Drake Tournament this past Sunday :) Noleeens: Next to no training on the animal and he placed very well.... suprised us all Oaks: Indeed! It it my hopes that people can use the new Animal Lore skill to weed out the weakling drakes Oaks: It's best that the weak drakes just be put out of their misery. * Noleeens laughs Noleeens: Poor little fellas.... a new market perhaps for runts? Oaks: Cannon fodder. Noleeens: And your least favorite change in Pub 16? Oaks: I really do like all of them... although the housing changes don't affect my play characters at all, because I don't own any houses. Noleeens: You live out of your bankbox? * Noleeens shudders at the thought Oaks: I'm a minimalist. Noleeens: And I own far too much pixel crack Oaks: Nothing wrong with that! Noleeens: Thanks... and hear I thought I was just a packrat hehe Noleeens: erm here Noleeens: So since you have been with OSI what is the one change that you have been responsible for that stick out most in your mind? Oaks: I think my favorite was not having to cut bandages one at a time... Noleeens: that was you?! Noleeens: nice! Oaks: The little things are often some of the best. Noleeens: Have you customized your music ingame at all? We were wondering if there was someway we could get a list of what music plays when so we can effectively customize our worlds :) Oaks: That's something you could bug ******<name removed to lessen the mail the fella might recieve... but Im on it!!> about (our lead client programmer)... I've yet to customize mine though. Noleeens: I think I read somewhere.. and I could be mixing things up here.... but didn't you work on the magic system a bit? Oaks: Yup. I've worked on it quite a bit. I revamped the low-level spells awhile back, I just worked on the 8th circle summon spells in publish 16, and I did nearly all of the particle effects in Third Dawn. Noleeens: Can we expect any new spells in the future? Maybe see that mystical 9th circle put to use? 새로운 마법들을 기대해도 될까요? 어쩌면 그 신비로운 9써클 마법도 도입될지도..? Oaks: Yes. And probably not... maybe? 네. 그리고 아마 안될걸요...어~~~쩌면? Noleeens: bah! 흥! Noleeens: Going back for a moment to that article you wrote about The Value of Rideables.... There was a pic with that article of a 'sand vortex'...... Noleeens: Have I just not been in the right place at the right time? or has this not actually been implemented yet? Oaks: It has not yet been introduced into the game. Oaks: I'm not quite sure when it *will* be introduced, either. That's the scenario team's thing. Noleeens: OK... now the fun part - where you get to skirt alot of questions :) (All the stuff not related to taming specifically) Oaks: Ok Noleeens: Recently we've seen some GM controlled spawns/mini-invasions, is something being implemented that will lead to this happening on a more regular basis? 최근에 GM이 직접 관여하는 몬스터 스폰이나 침략 이벤트가 있어 왔는데요, 이런 것들이 더 정기적으로 시행되도록 어떤 조치가 취해지고 있는건가요..? Oaks: I honestly don't know. If it's extremelly popular, there's always a good chance it'll happen more often. =) 솔직히 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 만약 그 이벤트들의 인기가 좋다면, 분명히 더욱 자주 열릴 가능성이 크겠지요.=) Noleeens: Stellerex was involved in game of chess... and I have seen talk of something referred to as a 'Tajima Hunt' ... is there a move to get the Dev team more exposure ingame? Oaks: I know all (well, at least most) the dev members are for it... it's a matter of organizing it and finding time now. Noleeens: neat! Oaks: No promises, but I'd certainly like to get involved myself and hunt down Tajima. Noleeens: Marriage deeds and inscribed rings.... is that something still being worked on? or has it fallen off the plate for now? 결혼 디드와 이름이 새겨진 반지... 아직 기획중인가요? 아니면 지금은 보류중? Oaks: We were talking about that the other day. It's definitely fallen off the plate for now. 그것에 관해 토론을 했었습니다. 지금은 전면 보류중이예요. Noleeens: 4th and 5th year vet rewards.... any status? 4년차 5년차 올드비 보상품에 관해서는.. 무슨 소식이라도? Oaks: No status on them, sorry to say. 그것에 대해선 아무런 구상도 되어 있지 않아요. 죄송합니다. Noleeens: What about Item Bless Deeds.... perhaps a vendor that could bless an article of clothing for you for xxx gold pieces or something like that - will we have the ability to bless clothing again in the future? 아이템 블레스 디드는요..? 특정 벤더에게 일정량의 돈을 지불하면 옷 한벌을 블레스 해주는건 어떨까나.. 예전처럼 언젠가 옷에 블레스를 걸 수 있게 될까요? Oaks: Clothing bless deeds are part of the tailoring BOD rewards in pub16. 옷 블레스 디드는 퍼블리쉬 16 테일러링 BOD 보상품중의 하나입니다. * Noleeens jaw drops Noleeens: I hadn't read that! 그건 들어본 적도 없는데요! Oaks: I believe they are one of the very high rewards. 분명 최고급 보상품중 하나이겠지요. Noleeens: What else is part of that new system? hehe Oaks: The new hued cloth has been a hot item. Oaks: There's a cloth hue that looks just like the fire steed. =) 새로운 색조의 천이 인기가 있더군요. 그 중에는 파이어 스티드와 똑같은 색도 있지요. =) Noleeens: That will be fun to play with! Noleeens: Any other insight into the high end rewards? Oaks: Those are the only 2 that come to mind. Hanse is the expert in that field. Noleeens: If you could say anything to the old school players that are feeling a bit discouraged with the changes that are coming in with Pub 16.... what would you say? 퍼블리쉬 16의 변경점에 실망한 올드비들에게 전할 말이 있다면..? Oaks: If, for some strange reason, they didn't find something wonderful in publish 16, I'd just suggest they sit tight because we are working on some k3wl stuffs. Oaks: Of which I cannot say any more! 만약 그들이 이런저런 이유로 인해 퍼블리쉬 16에서 마음에 드는 부분을 하나도 찾아내지 못한다면, 지금 대단히 멋진 것들을 개발중이므로 긴장하고 기다리시라는 말을 전하고 싶습니다. 더 자세한 건 가르쳐드릴 수 없어요! * Noleeens nods Noleeens: Of course :) Noleeens: That concludes the UO portion of the interview Oaks... but I still have two more questions :) Oaks: Ask away! Noleeens: If you could blend time periods, things, people, and events into a day's adventure, where would you be and with who? Oaks: I'd go back in time to when I didn't know anything about UO, and just play... exploring and meeting new people while I trekked across Brit was the best time I ever had in UO. Many a Mountain Dew and bag of potato chips provided sustance for 15+ hour sessions back then... Noleeens: hehe Noleeens: If the dead were to return to life as flesh-eating zombies, where would you hide out? * Noleeens loves those two questions Oaks: I'd cut off my hand, attach a chainsaw, load my double-barrel and wade into them... awyeah. Noleeens: heh Noleeens: Thanks again for your time Oaks :) Noleeens: one more thing... since you didn't run out the door Oaks: Sure. Noleeens: What other games are you playing? or have you tried and set aside recently? DAoC? Dungeon Siege? NWN? Oaks: NWN and Warcraft III Oaks: Nearly everyone at the office is playing NWN. It's a great game. ...사무실의 거의 모든 사람들이 네버윈터 나이츠를 플레이하고 있습니다. 정말 대단한 게임이예요. Noleeens: Ahhh someone gonna host a world? Oaks: And I recently finished Arcanum. Oaks: Oh, we're considering it. =) Oaks: Most of us are still just playing through the main module. Noleeens: Thanks again. ____________________________________________________________ 모두 번역을 해드리지 못하는 점 사과드립니다.. 다시 하려니 힘이 빠져서..-o- 출처: http://pub19.ezboard.com/fthedailyheraldfrm4.showMessage?topicID=7.topic
